The '''Junk Heap'''<ref name="TIA">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]] coding refers to the plant as "Junk Heap" when accessing the Debug menu.</ref> was the main processing plant on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], located in the [[Scraplands/Legends|Ord Mantell Scrapyard]]. It was the main gate for a long system of [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertrains]] that ran through the junkyard.

The Junk Heap would serve as [[IG-88D/Legends|IG-88D's]] headquarters after his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was damaged by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], until [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]] broke in and destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]].
